title: “A Virus Has No Religion”: Analyzing Islamophobia on Twitter During the COVID-19 Outbreak
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study specifically focused on analyzing Islamophobia, which is prejudice and hate speech directed at a religious community (Islam). It examines the impact of religious gatherings (Tablighi Jamaat) and religious observances (Ramadan) on online sentiment and investigates how religion was used as a symbol of patriotism and a target of discrimination.
